prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of La Diablesse, the Caribbean demi-human lure with the hidden hideous face and one cow hoof. COMPLETE REDRAW. Respectful nonsexual depiction of an adult African-Caribbean supernatural woman [la-diablesse-c01].
ANATOMY: ONE head, TWO arms with ordinary five-digit hands, TWO legs: EXACTLY ONE clearly CLOVEN COW HOOF with hairy fetlock on her forward leg, and ONE ordinary human bare FOOT with five toes on the other leg [la-diablesse-c02]. No extra feet or hooves, no horns. A VERY WIDE-BRIMMED STRAW HAT completely hides the eyes and upper face. Beneath brim ONLY LOWER FACE is partly revealed: hollow SUNKEN DISTORTED CHEEK, painfully asymmetrical stretched mouth curled into hideous cruel laughter, ordinary teeth unevenly packed in an unnaturally wide grin, deeply folded dark cheek shadows. This is the documented GOBLIN HORROR and HIDEOUS LAUGHTER [la-diablesse-c02,c09], NOT a warm smile, NOT glamorous, NOT a pretty fashion portrait. Do not make facial shape or ancestry itself monstrous; wrongness is supernatural distortion and cruel expression. No fangs, tusks or skull.
CLOTHING: high-necked, long-sleeved, fully opaque dark old dress covering all chest, arms and legs. NO cleavage, no bare knees/thighs, no low-cut bodice, no exposed shoulder. She holds the hem at ANKLE HEIGHT ONLY so the hoof is revealed below hem. Human foot exposed only below ankle; all shin, knee, thigh covered. No sexualised pose.
MOMENT: STEP out from motionless tall cane directly TOWARD viewer, lean forward slightly and beckon with one hand toward a completely dark forest opening beside the plantation [la-diablesse-c03,c07]. Hoof PLANTED prominently on the dusty foreground path, single human foot behind and distinctly separate. Other hand lifts skirt only slightly at ankle. Hideous lower-face laughter is legible in deep hat shadow, viewers feel the trap just exposed.
POWER: Bewitching lure implied through gesture and horror revelation only [la-diablesse-c03,c09]. No victim, spell effects or supernatural environmental transformation.
SCALE & CAMERA: Camera in front at KNEE-TO-HIP HEIGHT, looking horizontally forward with a slight upward tilt, NEVER under skirt or on ground. Tight full-figure confrontation, hat fills upper width, hidden eyes and distorted mouth in upper center, hoof large in lower foreground. Normal body scale, no invented giant size.
LIGHT & WEATHER: DEAD WINDLESS NOON [la-diablesse-c08]. BLEACHED WHITE-HOT SKY, harsh nearly vertical overhead sun, short pitch-black shadows, oppressive heat haze beyond the creature, no wind in cane or trees. Deep black hat shadow cuts across upper face; lower distorted mouth catches hard reflected sunlight. NO blue sky, NO fluffy clouds, NO moon, NO sunset, NO palm trees, NO cheerful resort mood.
SURFACE: coarse worn fully opaque dress, brittle straw hat, rough dusty cloven hoof, dry sunburnt earth, still cane stalks, painterly textured face.
SETTING: Isolated Martinique plantation cane-fields, distant small unoccupied plantation building, dark forest edge [la-diablesse-c07,c08]. Lure fills frame; background narrow and oppressive.
MOOD: immediately uncanny dangerous trap, goblin horror glimpsed under enormous brim, silent windless noon, neither glamorous nor ordinary holiday woman.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, logo, border, watermark, nudity, gore, victims, invented limbs/fingers, generic aura, neon outline, energy ribbons, floating runes or film/game/anime/comic designs.
